Isuzu East Africa Limited continues to record an
exemplary performance year on year with a focus on
regional diversification into the broader East African
market namely Uganda, Tanzania & Rwanda with a leading
market share at 45.0% of Kenya’s new motor vehicle
market as at December 2021. The business continues
to be active in enhancing economic activity having
produced and sold 5,608 and 163 units in the local and
export markets, respectively, which was a 32% and 117%
improvement from the 4,265 and 75 sold in the local and
export markets, respectively, in the previous year.
The growth was jointly driven by the improving economic
environment as well as increased capacity resulting
from the new assembly line launched towards the end
of FY20/21, for a new series of trucks. The business
continues to be a key player in the economy creating a lot
of employment opportunities as well as being an enabler
of business in a wide range of sectors.
